// diagnostic E3110

Jet.InvalidSwizzleLane

Lane `{lane}` isn't valid on `{type}`.

What

Lane `{lane}` isn't valid on `{type}`.

Why

Swizzle members name lanes with `x`/`y`/`z`/`w`; each type exposes only its lane count (`Vec2`: x/y, `Vec3`: x/y/z, …).

Fix

Use only the lanes defined for `{type}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidSwizzleLane: Tests/UI/swizzle_fixed_array_lane.stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidSwizzleLane: Lane `z` isn't valid on `[Int#2]`
  --> Tests/UI/swizzle_fixed_array_lane.jet:4:13
    |
  4 |     print(a.z)
    |             ^
 Why: Swizzle members name lanes with x/y/z/w — `[Int#2]` only has x and y
 Fix: Use only the lanes defined for `[Int#2]`
